engines.name: LokiDB
engines.notes: Default options. Unique indexes on id and email (lookups with by()), ranged index on age, DynamicView for the live query. Unmaintained since 2022.

engines.name: lokijs
engines.notes: Same configuration as LokiTS: default options, unique indexes on id and email, binary index on age.

engines.name: LokiTS
engines.notes: Default options (no cloning). Unique indexes on id and email (lookups with by()), binary index on age, DynamicView for the live query.

engines.name: RxDB
engines.notes: Memory storage, no dev-mode, no schema validator (the fastest setup). Indexes on email and age; string primary key (ids converted on insert). Live query through the query observable. Identical queries are answered from the RxDB query cache while the data does not change.

engines.name: SQLite
engines.notes: Official WASM build on the main thread, in-memory database, cached prepared statements, SELECT *. No live queries.

engines.name: TinyBase
engines.notes: Store with indexes on email and age (range = union of age slices). Ad hoc queries are defined, read and deleted per call so they are not maintained afterwards; top scores use getSortedRowIds. One transaction per bulk insert.

engines.name: Dexie
engines.durability: IndexedDB with the browser default durability
engines.notes: Primary key id, unique index on email, index on age; bulkAdd and bulkUpdate (one transaction each). Writes are persisted when they resolve.

engines.name: lokijs
engines.notes: IncrementalIndexedDBAdapter, same collection setup as LokiTS.

engines.name: LokiTS
engines.durability: one IndexedDB transaction per save, changed chunks only
engines.notes: Same collection setup as in memory; Loki.open, then saveDatabase() per write. LokiIndexedDBAdapter.

engines.name: LokiTS
engines.durability: one file per collection, atomically replaced files
engines.notes: Same collection setup as in memory; Loki.open, then saveDatabase() per write. LokiPartitioningAdapter over LokiOpfsAdapter, as the README recommends.

engines.name: SQLite
engines.durability: OPFS SAH pool VFS in a Worker, synchronous=FULL
engines.notes: Official WASM build in a dedicated Worker (OPFS needs one); every call crosses postMessage, as it would in an app.

engines.name: TinyBase
engines.notes: IndexedDB persister, explicit save() per write; email index rebuilt on open.
